```artifact
Feature: Hospital Services Coordination

  Scenario Outline: Coordinate activities in the Software Engineering process
    Given the system is initialized
    When a new activity is requested
    Then the system should coordinate the activity

    Examples:
      | activity |
      | Design   |
      | Testing  |
      | Deployment |

  Scenario Outline: Coordinate activities with guidance from Prof. Chandrasekaran
    Given the system is initialized
    And Prof. Chandrasekaran is available
    When a new activity is requested
    Then the system should coordinate the activity with guidance from Prof. Chandrasekaran

    Examples:
      | activity |
      | Design   |
      | Testing  |
      | Deployment |

  Scenario Outline: Provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists
    Given the system is initialized
    And a patient requests quality medicines
    When the system checks for available Chemists
    Then the system should provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists

    Examples:
      | patient | chemist_availability | expected_price |
      | Patient1| Available            | Discounted     |
      | Patient2| Unavailable          | Not Available  |

  Scenario Outline: Provide door-step Laboratory services
    Given the system is initialized
    And a patient requests Laboratory services
    When the system checks for available Chemists
    Then the system should provide door-step Laboratory services

    Examples:
      | patient | chemist_availability | collection_method |
      | Patient1| Available            | Home Collection  |
      | Patient2| Unavailable          | Not Available    |

  Scenario Outline: Handle unavailable Prof. Chandrasekaran
    Given the system is initialized
    And Prof. Chandrasekaran is unavailable
    When a new activity is requested
    Then the system should notify that Prof. Chandrasekaran is unavailable

    Examples:
      | activity |
      | Design   |
      | Testing  |
      | Deployment |

  Scenario Outline: Handle missing Chemist
    Given the system is initialized
    And a patient requests quality medicines
    When the system checks for available Chemists
    Then the system should notify that no Chemist is available

    Examples:
      | patient | chemist_availability | expected_price |
      | Patient1| Unavailable          | Not Available  |
```
